name: Wuxi Online Offline Communication Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Online Offline Communication Information Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of mobile information services in China. It operates in three segments: Mobile Information Services, Digital Marketing, and Others. The company mainly provides customers with software development, platform integration, parameter debugging, and operation and maintenance. The Digital Marketing segment offers various precise marketing services, including creative planning, content production, placement, monitoring, and placement strategy optimization. It serves customers in internet, finance, and express logistic industries. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Wuxi, China.
